f3_program: multiple(at("elmo.books.count", "current"), at("laura.books.count", "current"), 3, source("Elmo has 3 times as many books as his sister, Laura"))
multiple(at("laura.books.count", "current"), at("stu.books.count", "current"), 2, source("Laura has twice as many books as her brother, Stu"))
observe(at("elmo.books.count", "current"), 24, "count", source("Elmo has 24 books"))
query("value", at("stu.books.count", "current"))

offset(at("monster_box_cereal.price", "after_oversupply"), at("monster_box_cereal.price", "initial"), -24, "dollar", source("The price of a monster box of cereal is reduced by $24 after an oversupply in the market"))
observe(at("monster_box_cereal.price", "initial"), 104, "dollar", source("initial price was $104"))
add("purchase", "romina", at("romina.monster_box_cereal.count", "current"), 20, source("Romina bought 20 of such boxes"))

product_relation(at("romina.purchase.total_price", "purchase"), at("monster_box_cereal.price", "after_oversupply"), event_field("purchase", "quantity"), source("Romina bought 20 of such boxes, calculate the total price she paid"))
query("value", at("romina.purchase.total_price", "purchase"))
observe(at("colin.run.mile_duration", "mile_1"), 6, "minute", source("Colin ran his first mile in 6 minutes"))
observe(at("colin.run.mile_duration", "mile_2"), 5, "minute", source("He ran his next two miles in 5 minutes each"))
observe(at("colin.run.mile_duration", "mile_3"), 5, "minute", source("He ran his next two miles in 5 minutes each"))
observe(at("colin.run.mile_duration", "mile_4"), 4, "minute", source("finished his 4th mile in 4 minutes"))
query("mean", at("colin.run.mile_duration", "mile_1"), at("colin.run.mile_duration", "mile_2"), at("colin.run.mile_duration", "mile_3"), at("colin.run.mile_duration", "mile_4"))
observe(at("chocolate_chip_bag.chips.count", "full"), 81, "count", source("A bag of chocolate chips has 81 chips in it"))
observe(at("harry.cookie_dough.batches.count", "produced"), 3, "count", source("The dough makes three batches of cookies"))
observe(at("cookie.chocolate_chips.count", "per_cookie"), 9, "count", source("each cookie has nine chocolate chips in it"))
consume("use_bag", "harry", at("chocolate_chip_bag.chips.count", "current"), at("chocolate_chip_bag.chips.count", "full"), source("Harry uses a whole bag of chocolate chips"))

product_relation(event_field("use_bag", "quantity"), at("harry.cookie_dough.batches.count", "produced"), at("cookie_batch.cookies.count", "per_batch"), at("cookie.chocolate_chips.count", "per_cookie"), source("Harry uses a whole bag of chocolate chips when he makes dough for chocolate chip cookies. The dough makes three batches of cookies, and each cookie has nine chocolate chips in it"))
query("value", at("cookie_batch.cookies.count", "per_batch"))
assumptions: The singular "a batch" denotes the common size of each of the three batches.

f3_program: observe(at("lizette.quiz.score", "quiz_3"), 92, "score", source("Lizette scored 92 on her third quiz"))
observe(at("lizette.quiz.average_score", "after_quiz_3"), 94, "score", source("giving her an average of 94"))

mean_relation(at("lizette.quiz.average_score", "after_quiz_3"), at("lizette.quiz.score", "quiz_1"), at("lizette.quiz.score", "quiz_2"), at("lizette.quiz.score", "quiz_3"), source("Lizette scored 92 on her third quiz giving her an average of 94"))
query("mean", at("lizette.quiz.score", "quiz_1"), at("lizette.quiz.score", "quiz_2"))
